changes: Retain attempt78 three GPIO reset/startup and default touch charger0 baseline.
Between READY1 and GPIO reset2, load read-only factory record0x70 using A4 06 70; require matching echo, fresh counter, valid header and exact native umi module identity. No flash/calibration writes.
Bound read-only identity acquisition to one command and at most50 FIFO reads/100ms polling after native10ms delay. Error or unexpected reset stops explicitly.
Observe PM8150B GPIO5 SID2/c400 before startup and5s, following native always-on vdd_boost_vreg. Read-only mode/enable/source state, not an analog voltage measurement or proven FTS supply connection.
Retain mode comparison through30s and FIFO/raw/scan/HID logs. Remove redundant90s C1 mode capture to preserve trace capacity.
limitations: Identity read is a confirmed missing native probe operation, not yet proven cause of touch failure.
The native board boost node is always-on, but its electrical connection to FTS is unproven. No GPIO5 or boost writes.
Recovery replay uses software reset to avoid stealing GPIO from native driver; XNU uses its owned GPIO resets.
